sets.relationshipLabel: raw material becomes finished part through manufacture
sets.explanation: Steel is worked into a frame and rubber into a tire — each pair is a material transformed by making, not just a thing that has a part.

sets.relationshipLabel: the moment a journey begins and the moment it ends
sets.explanation: A race has its start and finish, a trip its departure and arrival — each pair names the two fixed endpoints of the same journey, in that order.

sets.relationshipLabel: a kind of thing and one of them by name
sets.explanation: A pass and a trail are categories; the Stelvio and the Camino de Santiago are specific, named instances of each.

sets.relationshipLabel: a role and the object that marks it
sets.explanation: The overall leader wears the yellow jersey and the best climber wears the polka dot jersey — a race role signaled by its distinctive garment.

glossary.definition: A famous winding mountain road in the Italian Alps, known for its many hairpin turns.
